source: Shipped pet_data table; numeric base stats and elementLevels only

1001100.description: They love food! When they search the forest for food, the glowing stars on their heads are often mistaken for comets. They like hoarding food, adorning their nest with it.

1001200.description: They prefer solitude and often move through the night. Their forms resemble mysterious mages draped in cloaks of stars, and they can teleport using psychic energy.

1001201.description: Stellaryses born in the rainy season are found more often on rainy days, as their skin requires constant moisture.

1001202.description: Prismatic energy enhances Stellarys’s magic, tinting the inside of its cloak with iridescent hues. In flight, it resembles shimmering spectrums of light.

1002100.description: That tough helmet keeps its squishy body safe, while those extendable mouth-claws help it hunt.

1002101.description: Clever-eyed Helmuts pad their helmets with fur shed by other Aniimo, keeping warm enough to venture out even on snowy days without freezing stiff.

1002102.description: A brave Helmut has polished its helmet to a brilliant shine through countless collisions, revealing what it looked like before years of rust took their toll.

1002200.description: A fledgling dragon that hides its weakness beneath its helmet, yearning to grow stronger so it can soar freely to every corner of the world in search of hidden treasures.

1002201.description: Evolved from the mountain-dwelling Jawling, its helmet is several times harder than its skin, protecting it from sharp rocks as it searches for minerals.

1002300.description: Covered in hard armor, they look like tall statues when they stand still, as if standing guard over ancient treasures.

1002301.description: Evolved from mountain-dwelling Helmwhelp, it relentlessly collects golden objects, longing to gild its entire body with splendid golden radiance.

1002400.description: It loves to take a bite out of anything it comes across. Its highly flexible jaw can open extremely wide. It shows affection and happiness through gentle nibbles, and especially loves biting metal objects because they are hard to damage.

1002401.description: Loves to sharpen its teeth on Metal ores. The Metal elements it consumes make its entire skin tougher, with its jaw becoming completely metallic.

1002500.description: Clad in heavy metal armor forged in searing flames, it can unleash a fury of fire that turns everything around it into molten lava. If you don’t want to be reduced to ash, stay as far away from it as possible.

1002503.description: Prismana causes Infergon’s Power of Fire to grow ever more violent, erupting from its armor as blazing violet flames, as if to reduce everything around it to ashes.

1002600.description: Armed with a broken sword and armor, blessed with courage and might, it defends its friends and challenges its foes.

1002601.description: To stay active in snowy weather, they reshape their blades into axes and wrap fur shed by other Aniimo around their joints to keep warm.

1002602.description: Obsessed with challenging powerful foes, it lets every attack it endures polish its armor to a brighter shine, ultimately forging this magnificent golden battle armor.

1002603.description: Prismatic energy awakens the lingering will of the dragon once defeated by this sword, causing its claws and sharp horns to sprout from Pawney’s armor and weapons.

1002700.description: Despite its imposing size, it is timid and gentle, always avoiding conflict. Whenever danger approaches, it curls up into a ball, but it always musters the courage to fight when its friends need protection.

1002701.description: They pad their armor with the fur of other Aniimo for warmth and better traction on snow when they curl up.

1002702.description: Shouldering the duty of protecting its clan, its armor has been polished to gold after blocking countless attacks, radiating with the light of courage.

1003100.description: If the only way to evolve is to defeat other Wisptises, then there is no other choice but to keep their claws sharp.

1003101.description: The fungi in the fog turn their shells into a grayish-green color and spread spores by flapping their wings.

1003103.description: They polish their claws until they are red-hot, adding a fiery glow to their cuts. Flames blaze as they spin and fly through the forest, honing their skills.

1003200.description: They sharpen their blades and wait for the perfect moment, hiding in the shadows as they toy with their prey. As cold-blooded assassins, they seek to end every fight in a single strike.

1003201.description: The fungal infection has distorted their shells and covered their wings with spores that spread when they flap.

1003202.description: The prismana dyes their sickles crimson as their black figures hide in the night like assassins.

1003203.description: They sharpen dual blades to accumulate heat, which is released instantly upon a strike. Every cut inflicts both slash and burn wounds.

1003300.description: Evolved from a Wisptis with broken forelimbs absorbing the power of lightning. The reshaped reverse blades are incredibly sharp and flash with dazzling electric light.

1003305.description: Prismana energy gives Fulmintis a fresh burst of power, turning it into a red blur on the battlefield. This time, it’s not looking back!

1004100.description: They like to hide underwater and observe their surroundings using a lotus leaf as a strikingly ineffective disguise.

1004101.description: Skippies that inhabit the Sea of Flowers consume flower petals. The pigments slowly accumulate in their bodies, transforming their head leaf and skin into a delicate pinkish-red.

1004102.description: Skippies living in cold regions don't find the snow cold at all; instead, they enjoy the cool feeling of the frozen head leaf on their heads.

1004200.description: They like to stay cool and moist. That’s what the layer of film over their bodies is for.

1004201.description: Its pink body blends perfectly with the flower sea, while its gills wave like flower branches dancing in the wind.

1004202.description: Prankies living in cold regions have frost on their gills and tail fins, and their membranes are covered in snow, making them appear thicker.

1004300.description: They are elegant and kind Aniimo that always take care of weaker ones, and freeze anyone who crosses them in ice.

1004301.description: Evolved from Sea of Flowers-dwelling Pranky, it has a dreamy pink body. When running, the skin membranes on its back undulate like endless rolling pink waves.

1004302.description: Glacies living in cold regions have their gills and tail fins covered in solid ice shells. The biting cold proclaims the majesty of the Lord of Ice and Snow.

1004303.description: Prismana power flows softly through Glacy, like sunlight passing through its body and scattering across its scales in radiant color.

1004500.description: They live among lotus flowers and use their lotus leaf tails to conceal their face and show off their elegant nature.

1005100.description: Lively and energetic, the creatures like to follow Flameruffs around. Once their fluffy charcoal-like fur starts to burn, they grow.

1005101.description: Emberpups living in the mountains have rock-like fur colors and a shaggy coat created by the mountain winds.

1005104.description: Emberpup living in sunny mountain forests have warm golden-yellow fur tips that seem to leave traces of sunshine as they run.

1005200.description: Pack creatures that prize loyalty and unity, these hunters have calm, focused eyes that conceal their fiery hearts.

1005201.description: Flameruffs living in the mountains have perfect camouflage and lava-coated claws for running in extremely hot areas.

1005204.description: Living in mountain forests, the golden tips of its dark fur stand out prominently, a display of its confidence and pride as a wolf pack leader.

1005300.description: The scorch marks on their bodies are proof of victories in battle. They seek strong opponents to dominate.

1005301.description: Their front legs are covered in lava from hitting melted rocks, allowing them to inflict more damage on opponents.

1005302.description: Struck by thunder, their muscles are enhanced, and the flames all over them turn blue as they burn hotter.

1005303.description: Heat radiates as the Prismana pulls flames from their chests and weaves them around their bodies.

1005304.description: A Scorchhowl living in mountain forests appears to have absorbed all available sunlight into its fur, radiating brilliant golden light.

1005500.description: A Flameruff who challenged the strong and lost. Having absorbed the souls of companions who fell with equal bitterness, it is driven by the desire for revenge.

1005503.description: Driven by Prismana, the flames of vengeance burn ever more fiercely, scorching Inferlupa’s body. The drifting soul-heads at its side let out frenzied howls, releasing a chilling aura of overwhelming pressure that strikes fear into the heart.

1012200.description: Troubled by the beat of its own heart, Besauce constantly searches for rhythms to drown it out. It loves to groove to music and has a passion for avant-garde music.

1013100.description: An energetic pup with a pair of big ears. The ice-bone bow tie on its chest is its favorite toy. It hates Emberpups that don’t respect personal space.

1013102.description: A young Bonesky adapted to nocturnal life. Their fur has dimmed for camouflage in the night, while their crimson eyes grant them keen vision to pierce the darkness.

1013200.description: Resisting gentle pets that might soften its resolve, it leads family hunts with its ice blade.

1013202.description: Dark grey fur blends seamlessly with the night, save for a patch of blood-red fur at the tail base, which, along with their crimson eyes, signals danger.

1013300.description: Proud and confident warriors, they send shivers down their enemies’ spines with the chilling blades in their mouths.

1013301.description: The prismana turns the tips of their fur and the blades in their mouth red as a warning to other creatures.

1013302.description: Arrogant hunters beneath the moon. The ice blade between their teeth gleams coldly in the night, sharp as condensed frost.

1014100.description: Their first reaction to everything is to escape, and their bulb-like organs indicate whether they are healthy.

1014200.description: A light-dependent creature that glows when night falls, keeping its light on even while sleeping.

1014300.description: Changes its glow to match its mood while its tentacles create mesmerizing patterns and deliver shocking attacks.

1014301.description: Their skin is extremely thin, and they rely heavily on moisture. Since their bodies hold so much water, even the slightest bump makes it seep from their eyes, leaving them looking like they’re always crying.

1014302.description: Prismatic energy strengthens the electrical organ on their head, allowing them to channel stored electricity into a gentle healing light that mends the wounds of their injured companions.

1016100.description: Mating for life, they’re always found in pairs. The heartbloom atop their shells indicates their state of happiness.

1016101.description: They craft wigs out of sand, decorate their fur with nice pebbles, and exchange pebbles with their friends.

1016102.description: For Budclaws that live on the beach, wearing a coconut husk is a no-brainer, both for protection and camouflage.

1016103.description: Budclaw living in coastal bays love to sunbathe until their shells turn bright red, using their vibrant coloration to attract potential mates.

1016200.description: The lush plants that cover their shells convert sunlight into nutrients, so they don’t even need to eat on sunny days.

1016201.description: Heaps of sand remain on the ground when they tunnel, and it’s annoying that someone else keeps stealing their pebbles.

1016202.description: The fruit on Shrubclaw’s back fall into the sand when they are ripe and grow into food and shelter for Budclaws.

1016203.description: Evolved from bay-dwelling Budclaw, it maintains its sunbathing habit, though excessive sun exposure has caused the plants on its head to become somewhat dehydrated and discolored.

1016300.description: They live in caves, feed on minerals, and use their beautifully crystallized shells to lure prey.

1017100.description: They dig around to search for gifts to give to their crushes, but their wooing always fails because they are so shy.

1017101.description: The dark circles under their eyes come from digging for treasures all night, and their fur has become night-black.

1017200.description: They select shells and make them into shovels. It’s said that they produce pink bubbles when they see someone they love.

1017201.description: These Popotas spend their nights thinking about their crushes, and their fur is now colorless due to their bitter mood.

1017300.description: Narcissistic little creatures who spend a large amount of time grooming their fur and striking the perfect pose.

1017301.description: The lack of sun exposure makes their fur colorless since they only go on dates at night, but it looks kind of cool.

1017400.description: They are strong and powerful, but they’d rather stay in their nests and decorate than show off their muscles.

1017401.description: Panpantas like to search for decorative shells on the beach at night, which explains the dark circles under their eyes

1017402.description: Its treasured shell has been reshaped by Prismana light into a symbol of command. Power surges through Panpanta, fluffing up its fur. One pat on its round belly, and mighty waves rise at its side as if awaiting orders!

1018100.description: They often hover at low altitudes, paying attention to every movement on the beach and causing a ruckus.

1018101.description: The seaweed mixed in the food of Chirpis dyes their feathers with the color of the waves.

1018103.description: Chirpis living in the highlands have feathers the color of fallen leaves. Fluffy hair covers their eyes, adding a casual vibe.

1018400.description: They like having fun and producing rhythmic music, so don’t be surprised to see a grand symphony.

1018401.description: They love walking in the sea breeze and are always in a good mood. Sometimes they just start playing and dancing.

1018403.description: Trombers living in the highlands love to stroll in the sunlight, playing melodious tunes from their flower-shaped horns accompanied by the mountain breeze.

1018500.description: They can produce loud, piercing noises that resonate throughout the entire beach just to draw attention.

1018501.description: Standing on a high reef, they practice diligently to make their voices carry farther across the sea, as if convinced that one day, an echo will come from the other side.

1018502.description: The Prismana has enhanced their vocal organs so they can mimic the sounds of other instruments to accompany themselves.

1018503.description: Cornets living in the highlands love to fly high in the morning, waking everything up with loud calls and turning a deaf ear to any complaints.

1018700.description: Creates deep, tuba-like sounds that match its steady, friendly character.

1018701.description: As they walk along the beach and play, the beat washes over them like waves, as if they can hear the ocean resonating.

1018703.description: Tubsters living in the highlands roll up grass leaves to decorate the venue. Whenever their horn sounds, the show never gets boring.

1019100.description: Conceals itself among beach shells using its soft appendages to hold shells in place. Remains sealed during daylight.

1019200.description: Lying on their shells, they face the night sky, falling into a deep dream woven by the stars.

1019400.description: They turn the shells that once covered them into swords and shields to protect fragile Shellies along the coastline.

1019401.description: The storm-born Sherros absorb lightning with their antennae, looking down upon the sea they guard like kings.

1019402.description: Guided by Prismana, its determination to uphold justice casts a golden glow across Sherros’ shell armor.

1020100.description: They live on the grassland in groups, they like burrowing for nutrients, and they love singing off-key together!

1020101.description: Altered by the earth, their skin becomes mineral-red and thicker to keep their bodies hydrated.

1020300.description: They make bizarre noises to drive intruders to madness, lower their defenses and even cause them to pass out.

1020301.description: Due to changes of minerals in soil and increased sunlight exposure, their skin has transformed into a striking orange-red, while the flowers on their heads have become more vibrant.

1020302.description: Prismatic energy gathers within the Hexxin’s veins, making its body and the inside of its leaf hat glow with mesmerizing light, as well as strengthening its ability to invade minds.

1020700.description: They need to absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots to maintain vitality and hate leaving the ground.

1020701.description: Due to changes in soil composition, its skin has taken on an orange-red hue after absorbing minerals from the Earth, also becoming thicker and more robust.

1021100.description: Iris possesses an extremely lightweight body, often lifted by the wind. It then either slowly spirals downward using the resistance from its petal skirt, or simply allows itself to be carried away by the wind.

1021101.description: These Irises are highland dwellers. The abundant minerals in the soil give them a maple-red color.

1021102.description: These Irises live in the Forest of Falling Stars. They like to rest under trees and their stamens light up in the night.

1021103.description: These Irises live in the Nimbus Fields. They enjoy bathing in the grassland sunshine and, without realizing it, collect tufts of wool on their petals.

1021104.description: The Prismana can nurture a one-of-a-kind blossom and allow it to thrive within the Sea of Flowers.

1021105.description: Irises living in the highlands have dark blue petals dotted with fine snow, blooming bravely and swaying freely in the cold.

1021106.description: Irises living in mountain forests dance among the verdant bushes, their petals glowing with a lustrous green hue.

1021200.description: Devoted to the art of dance, they constantly hone their craft, hoping to share the pure joy and energy of movement.

1021201.description: Evolved from highland-dwelling Irises, the abundant minerals in the soil give them a maple-red color.

1021202.description: Evolved from Irises that live in the Forest of Falling Stars, these moon dancers spread luminous pollen as they dance.

1021203.description: Evolved from Irises that inhabit the Nimbus Fields, their dances after basking in the sunshine are full of vitality.

1021204.description: Each vein is suffused with iridescent hues of the prismana, brimming with radiant brilliance. An unfading skirt sways across the land, casting an extra touch of brightness upon the world.

1021205.description: Evolved from Irises in the highlands. Cold dew freezes on the edges of dark blue petals, dancing with the skirt like fluttering snow.

1021206.description: Evolved from Irises in mountain forests, they have taken on an elegant verdant color nurtured by the wild. As they dance, they release the fresh fragrance of greenery.

1021300.description: They absorb the world’s colors as floral raiment, bringing colorful vitality to nature. If petals wither, they can bloom again by returning to the earth’s embrace.

1022100.description: They live among the trees. When they attack, golden sparks flash from their tails with crackling electric sounds. Agile and quick on their feet, they are very difficult to catch.

1022102.description: Living in sunny woodland regions, its lighter body color helps it avoid absorbing too much heat, while its special golden-brown fur allows it to blend into its surroundings.

1022200.description: It stores power by using the static electricity in its special fur to attract charged particles from the air. Water weakens this ability, so it rarely appears on rainy days.

1022201.description: The power of prismana weaves through their fur, emitting blinding and threatening rays, warning others to stay away.

1022202.description: Evolved from Bolties that dwell in mountain forests, they have a lighter body color and layers of intertwined golden-brown special fur that disorient their opponents.

1022300.description: They use their special fur to capture charged particles in the air to produce and store electricity.

1023100.description: They are timid and hide whenever they sense danger, but the fluorescent scales they shake off always give them away.

1023101.description: These Sea of Flowers dwellers have purple wings and antennae shaped like flower spikes for camouflage.

1023102.description: They love flowers that blossom at night. The colors of the night are painted on their wings for better concealment.

1023103.description: Naturally timid Aniimo whose wings mimic fallen leaves in shape and color, allowing them to quickly hide in piles of fallen leaves.

1023200.description: Lone wanderers. They create illusions by shedding scales from their wings when threats approach.

1023201.description: They weave through flowers and spread pollen with their wings. That’s why their scales smell like flowers.

1023202.description: They can perfectly blend into the night. And their luminous scales can both confuse enemies and signal their friends.

1023203.description: Aniimo inhabiting deciduous forests whose wings layer like fallen leaves. They often rest on piles of leaves, lazily bathing in the autumn light while looking sleepy.

1023300.description: Their magnificent wings spread scales to help flowers grow and spread vitality wherever they fly.

1026100.description: Don’t be surprised to see them floating in the clouds in small groups above the grasslands.

1026101.description: Absorbing water changes the color of their fur and makes it conductive, capable of holding lightning within.

1026102.description: Appear to prefer the fragrance of Sunny Daisy over grass, which has given their wool a slight golden tinge that absorbs more heat than pure white wool.

1026105.description: Gloomy and dislikes being disturbed, they love to curl up in corners to brood, wrapping themselves in layers of sorrowful clouds.

1026200.description: They like to sleep hidden in the clouds, because with the presence of wind pressure and static electricity, the fluffy wool easily attracts things carried by the winds.

1026201.description: Like thunder clouds, electricity flickers within their fur and randomly strikes innocent passersby when they are upset.

1026202.description: They prefer sleeping while floating atop the upper layers of Nimbus clouds, allowing them to greet the day’s first rays and bathe in golden light above the sea of clouds.

1026204.description: After absorbing Prismana energy, the Turbo’s wool is dyed with the colors of a starry night, making the surrounding clouds glow.

1026205.description: Their fur wraps around the cold and their bad mood. The frost within encases their horns in ice.

1026300.description: Their fur that has absorbed dream energy presents a mesmerizing illusion of colors. When the fur is used as a pillow, Pathfinders sink into sweet dreams.

1028100.description: They are natural geologists who like eating all kinds of ores. And what they eat determines how they grow.

1028200.description: They use hard claws to crush crystals and eat them to store heat, causing fiery red patterns to appear on their body. Though small, they can continuously spew high-heat flame streams from their mouth.

1028300.description: Scorching crystals grow on their body like solidified lava. If the stored heat erupts, it can melt everything in their path.

1028301.description: The crystals on their back absorb prismana energy, erupting with magnificent energy jets and radiating terrifying heat.

1028400.description: The minerals they eat are refined within their bodies and transformed into crystal spines infused with pure energy.

1028500.description: Wherever crystal minerals are found, so are they. Their hard spines serve both as protection and as storage for energy.

1029100.description: They always wear their signature smiles and invite other Aniimo to play. Their mischief and greed may get them into trouble now and then, but they’re always forgiven.

1029300.description: With their highly conductive fur, they harness the power of lightning to extend their wings and dash forth, dispelling the haze and lifting their spirits.

1029301.description: Affected by Prismana, their fur turns a romantic candy color. Their smile alone makes people feel the sweet taste of happiness.

1032100.description: The timid crybabies can also rise up against enemies when cornered. The buds on their heads will blossom as they do so.

1032103.description: The thorn in Budsquire’s hand may be soft and fragile, but its courage is not. To protect what it holds dear, it follows Thornblade without hesitation.

1032300.description: The swords made from thorny stems are drawn only when it’s time to protect their family against enemies.

1032301.description: These cold-blooded assassins hone their skills on rainy nights, their eyes as sharp as lightning. Once they fix their gaze on their prey, there's no escape.

1032302.description: Their swords, covered in prismana, can never be broken, no matter how hard they are struck.

1032303.description: With an unshakable heart, it has become a true knight in its own right. Thornblade will honor its vow to protect and drive away every intruder.

1032400.description: To quell disputes, they scatter fragrant petals, causing those who touch them to feel happiness and crush their fighting spirit.

1032402.description: Prismana transforms the pure white floral gown into a crystal-like skirt, shimmering with dazzling light as it sways. The thorns entwining the roses form a crown, each sharp point softened into a gentle protection.

1033100.description: Though they look like fire, those flames are only flowing energy. They give off no heat at all—in fact, they absorb heat from their surroundings. Sometimes they use this to disguise themselves as campfires and play tricks on others.

1033101.description: They love pulling pranks, particularly by sneaking up on others and scaring them at night. They’ll be upset if their pranks don’t work.

1033102.description: Sparkis in a different color after absorbing fog as their fuel. Don’t follow them into the fog, or you’ll get lost.

1033103.description: Sparkis in a different color after absorbing pollen as their fuel. Be careful of them in the Sea of Flowers at night.

1033300.description: They only come out at night. Since their bodies are made of gaseous energy, they can split at will and even create clones.

1033301.description: Flamerions in a different color due to altered gas composition. They like to sneak up and scare others.

1033302.description: Flamerions in a different color after absorbing fog as their fuel. Pretending to be glowing plants is their trick.

1033303.description: Flamerions in a different color after absorbing pollen as their fuel. They can make flowers look like they’re on fire.

1035100.description: As partners to perfumers, they store and ferment nectar within their bodies, transforming it into perfume ingredients.

1035200.description: They’re picky about odors, so they harvest and store various nectar within them to craft unique perfume ingredients.

1036100.description: Enthusiastic and confident, they always stand up for their friends at critical moments, displaying amazing power.

1036300.description: As the golden radiance flows over their bodies like the power of the sun, their majesty is revealed.

1037100.description: Their eyes shimmer with the deep blue light of the moon, and mysterious patterns appear when they wield their power.

1037300.description: The soft moonlight running through their fur gives them an aloof and rational look. But they can also be sentimental.

1038100.description: They burrow underground to camouflage as coral and bite any prey that comes near. However, they sometimes get impatient and peek around.

1038103.description: Without sunlight, Reefish grows sour and irritable. The shell-like layer on its back twists into jagged edges, cutting anything that comes too close.

1038300.description: They love to bury themselves in sand, mimicking coral clumps. They use the glow of the coral on their head and back to lure creatures for a surprise attack.

1038303.description: Under the falling rain, danger grows as quietly as the coral spines along its back. It slips through the downpour without a sound, waiting for one careless move from its prey.

1039100.description: The wave-splitting Saws is crazy about chasing creatures through the water. When it dashes, its serrated dorsal fin can quickly slice through anything in the raging current that gets in its way.

1039300.description: A ferocious hunter that treats its extendable lower jaw as a weapon, it cruises between the shadows of the waves. The moment its grim dorsal fin breaks the surface, its prey has nowhere left to run.

1039301.description: Prismatic Energy strengthens Whirlbite’s skeleton, letting it dive into even deeper ocean trenches. In the pitch-black, it gives off a faint eerie glow, luring in unsuspecting prey.

1040100.description: Prawnch trains hard in the rapids, raising its claw-fists high and picking fights with every opponent in sight. It even treats passing creatures as imaginary enemies. The more it gets ignored, the more it itches to throw down.

1040300.description: A master of all kinds of boxing combos, it constantly hones its techniques. With head-bobs and tail-wags as feints to confuse its opponent, it then ricochets its claw-fist forward for a fight-ending blow.

1040302.description: After absorbing Prismatic Energy, this star boxer burns with passion for the sport. Even without a cheering crowd, it still shadowboxes over the water, throwing left and right and drumming up its own rhythm with the wind of its punches.

1040303.description: Jabster tempers its body in raging currents. It swings its claw-fists to split the rushing flow, and the rotating water even coils around both fists. Every calm move oozes the poise of a true fighting master.

1043100.description: Cozites build their shells bit by bit with mud. When in danger, they spray smoke from the top hole to cover the surroundings and hide themselves.

1043300.description: Their upper and lower bodies can rotate independently, allowing Bailites to survey their surroundings with ease and transform into turrets to drive off opponents.

1044100.description: With their big ears perked up, they are extremely sensitive to sound. They won’t miss any movement that catches their attention, near or far.

1044300.description: Curious and eager to search for traces and track targets. The ring on their tail amplifies ultrasound, allowing them to easily detect cloaked creatures.

1044400.description: Elusive Ekrim can skillfully grab treasures with the talon on its tail and then vanish into the darkness without a trace.

1044403.description: Under the influence of iridescent energy, Ekrim grows razor-sharp bony spurs at its wing joints, and its tail-tip turns into a scythe-like blade. It darts through the night at will, snatching every hidden treasure from the shadows.

1045100.description: From the moment it’s born, it’s inseparable from its mud ball, rolling it again and again until it gets rounder and rounder. But the mud ball it pushes doesn’t seem as simple as it looks.

1045101.description: In the snowfields, it keeps pushing the mud ball it’s had since birth, packing it with a thick coat of frost and snow. Then it shows off all kinds of high-difficulty moves on the ice.

1045300.description: They move backwards like their kin, but in a much fancier way.

1045301.description: Waleetles speeding through the snow wrap frozen thorns around their snowballs like chains, keeping them from flipping even when racing across smooth ice.

1045302.description: After absorbing Prismatic Energy, Waleetle’s instinct for top speed erupts into flame, burning its mud ball into blistering lava. When it dashes, the roar shakes the air and firelight surges, as if it’s about to crush everything ahead.

1045400.description: The minerals packed into its mud ball gradually bind and compress through constant jolts, turning it into a stone ball and awakening consciousness within. Sick of being pushed around, it devours an insect body and can finally move by its own will.

1045401.description: A Bouldus that lives in the snowfield. They roll constantly in the snow, compressing the frost on their bodies into solid ice crystals, including the carrot that came from nowhere.

1047100.description: They retreat into their shells to rest, often getting mistaken for eggs. They fear battle but love a crowd, dancing with grass pompoms to cheer others on.

1047101.description: These Pomeggs shiver with runny noses in the freezing snow. They balance snowballs on their heads for camouflage, looking just like tiny snowmen when they retract into their shells.

1047102.description: Highland Pomeggs pile fallen leaves on their heads to blend in. However, this disguise blocks their vision, so they sometimes slip and roll down the slopes.

1047103.description: Pomeggs living in the Sea of Flowers wear blooms on their heads as camouflage. Their bodies absorb the pigments, turning a soft, pale pink.

1047400.description: They have flexible limbs and love to show off their flashy kicks to anyone watching. They wear their shed skin over their heads like a cool hood.

1047500.description: Their towering manes display their wild nature, while their feral roars reveal their true colors. Their tails are built to store sound waves, releasing a sonic boom when they strike an opponent.

1047501.description: The freezing climate turns their manes into ice spikes, highlighting their rebellious streak. Their shed skin forms a tight-fitting suit, allowing them to maintain both style and warmth in the cold.

1047502.description: They roam the highland fields with stiff manes shaped like sycamore leaves. These leaves sway freely in the wind, rustling alongside their hoarse voices.

1047503.description: They evolved from the Pomeggs of the Sea of Flowers. Their skin remains vibrant even after shedding, but the spikes on their heads show that they are quite the "prickly" characters.

1048100.description: They rub the oils on their bodies to create lots of foam that cleans and protects them, though they sometimes step on it and slip.

1048300.description: Their feathers constantly secrete oil, which produces all kinds of bubbles with just a little rubbing. Naturally, they use the softest, fluffiest foam to protect the Fahloos on their backs.

1050100.description: They spend their days sleepwalking. The moment they are awakened, they become agitated and lose control. Once they run out of energy, they peacefully drift back to sleep like a baby.

1050300.description: Beneath their gentle exterior lies constant restraint and suppressed aggression. However, when provoked or hungry, they lose control and fall into a frenzy.

1050301.description: Prismana energy soothes their rampaging souls, guiding them into sweet dreams. But if anyone disturbs their slumber, they will be enraged and be your worst nightmare.

1051100.description: Squarrel has a large, fist-shaped tail. When its greasy tail fur is rubbed even slightly, it can burst into flames. Anyone who eyes its stockpiled pinecones will get a taste of its scorching fire fists.

1051200.description: Squashel has twin fist-like tails, giving its power a super-boost. Pinecones thrown with that force strike like cannonballs — not to be underestimated.

1054100.description: Lively and mischievous, Lilipole loves to swish its long leaf-like tail and play around in the water. Whether it’s one of its own kind or a passing Aniimo, someone’s always getting splashed by its sudden spray.

1054300.description: Though it’s round and chubby, Scrubbit is surprisingly nimble. That shed long tail-leaf in its hands is both a scrub towel for washing its body and a sharp tool for whipping opponents.

1054302.description: The rainy weather sets the stage for a romantic moment. Now blushing pink, Scrubbit cradles a bouquet for its date and even decorates itself with dewdrop petals tied like a butterfly bow.

1057100.description: Keen-eared, it can pick up every tiny sound around it. The moment it senses an intruder, it locks on with its big eyes, then unleashes hypnotic waves to confuse its target.

1057300.description: Mesmerowl beats its ear-feather wings as it patrols its territory at low altitude. When it unleashes hypnotic waves, its glowing tail tuft swings like a pendulum, leaving its opponent even more dazed.

1057400.description: Lazy yet sharp, Hypnyto loves to lounge in soft, cozy nests. The pair of eye-like markings on its wings enhance the hypnotic effect when it releases its waves.

1057403.description: Prismatic Energy tints Hypnyto’s feathers a captivating pink. When it goes all-out with its hypnosis, the heart-shaped plumage on its wings aids the effect, leaving its opponent completely defenseless and unable to resist.

1058100.description: It stretches its leafy feathers with lazy ease, always chewing away as it turns algae and slime into floating bubbles. One light hop, and off it drifts, riding the bubbles like a little boat in the breeze.

1058300.description: Draped in fresh green leaf-feathers, Glameep moves lightly along the lake shore. It adores clear water most of all, especially when that water reflects its own graceful, unhurried beauty.

1058301.description: Prismana has transformed Glameep’s leaf-feathers into something clear and glass-like, while the golden branch on its head has grown into a crown, as if nature itself had chosen to bless it.

1058302.description: After weathering a storm’s trial, Glameep’s leaf-feathers are torn and tugged by raging winds, growing even more rugged and free-flowing as they whip wildly through the gale. Its bold, untamed presence hits you head-on.

1059100.description: Sugarfish likes to stay in the shade, but once it’s out in the sun, it secretes slime to protect its fragile skin, making it look like it’s melting.

1059300.description: Sugarslime is naturally warm and outgoing. It loves to scoop up slime in the shell it carries and share it with other Aniimo, but its odd looks often scare them off. Luckily, it’s so forgetful that the gloom fades fast.

1059400.description: Sugartini is all about appearances. To avoid messing up its carefully styled look, it keeps up a graceful demeanor at all times. But if you point out that its “bangs” are actually its nose, it instantly flies into a rage.

1059403.description: Prismatic Energy seeps into its formless body of slime, giving it a completely new look. The flow of muck gathers into a graceful fishtail, its long hair ripples like rolling waves, and the spiral crown atop its head is simply dazzling.

1060100.description: Salabask’s head looks like a piece of driftwood covered in moss. It loves soaking in the water with only its head above the surface, basking in the sun. Sometimes other Aniimo mistake it for a floating plank to cross the river, and one careless step can knock it out cold.

1060300.description: It loves to float motionless on the river’s surface, soaking up the sun, and doesn’t mind being used like driftwood to step across. Just don’t stand on its back too long. It might suddenly flip over.

1061100.description: It flits busily through the night, gathering pollen from glowing plants and carefully rolling it into pretty pollen balls to bring back to the hive. When danger strikes, it swings the pollen ball like a weapon to bash its enemies.

1061300.description: A burly powerhouse with exceptional strength but none of the brute attitude, it’s gentle at heart and meticulous in action. It patrols tirelessly around the hive, day and night, protecting the swarm.

1061400.description: The queen of the swarm and the hive’s highest ruler, she is revered by her kin and lives within the royal nest the workers craft for her, commanding the entire swarm.

1061403.description: It feeds on nectar steeped in Prismana, while Prismana-dusted pollen drifts down from its crown. Graceful wings trail behind the queen, and its floral raiment, blooming in Prismana, shimmers with opulent radiance.

1062100.description: It loves collecting colorful bubbles. They bob and sway inside its air sac as it moves, and when inspiration strikes, it uses them to doodle strange little wonders in the air.

1062300.description: With a quick tap from its nimble tentacles, it can launch all kinds of capsule bubbles from its head. No one knows what will pop out next, a delightful surprise or a complete accident.

1062304.description: Prismana in the night sky sparks Gachapus’s imagination of the galaxy, awakening a longing for the cosmos. Even the bubbles in its head take on the shape of tiny planets.

1063100.description: Coinwisp’s cap looks just like an oversized gold coin. It often hides inside, mischievously luring other creatures into chasing it. When danger strikes, it flings its cap to confuse its opponent, then slips away.

1063300.description: Its body is like a super-springy giant coin pouch, home to a whole swarm of Pennywisps. It may look like it’s generously tossing gold coins everywhere, but it’s really just letting the Pennywisps out to play.

1063303.description: Prismatic Energy is drawn into Pouchwisp’s belly. As that abundant energy condenses into dazzling crystals, elegant gold patterns bloom across its body. Even the Pennywisps living on it glow with a brilliant golden radiance.

1065100.description: Dewlop is active around waterways. Its body is almost entirely made of water, letting it shift shapes with ease. Maybe it’s just in its nature. It always wants to blend into any body of water it comes across.

1065101.description: Under the influence of the surging Water element within the waterfall, the Water flowing through Dewlop turns turbulent too—its tiny body roiling with the power of a raging current.

1065300.description: Made up of multiple Dewlops, Dewple’s individuals may drift apart now and then, but they never truly separate—always moving in sync as they follow the largest one.

1065301.description: Under the influence of the surging Water Element within the waterfall, Dewple grows ever more fired up. The water coursing over its body surges faster, churning nonstop like rapids.

1069100.description: As Jeglid bursts from the water’s surface, the flying fins on either side blast out stored water with force, launching it into the air for a glide. Its form is especially agile and strong.

1069102.description: Tempered by storms, the edges of its fins are riddled with scars left by wind and waves. Its body has only grown stronger. No matter how fierce the rapids, nothing can stop it from pressing onward.

1069300.description: The wing membranes sprouting from its forelimbs are airy yet tough. Two well-developed pairs of water storage organs on its wings can jet powerful streams, pushing its body like an arrow to cleave through the water pressure, surge upstream, and vault all the way to the top of the falls.

1069301.description: Influenced by Prismatic Energy, Jeburst’s wings shift into tranquil, deep starry-sky hues. It beats its wings and flies against the current toward even higher peaks, leaping into the far end where the seas of stars converge.

1069302.description: Weaving through raging winds and rushing currents, it’s tempered into a fearsome silhouette like a roaring wave. The harsher the storm, the tougher it becomes—no gale or towering swell can blunt its wave-splitting edge!

1071300.description: Jaguaraun’s neck fur is incredibly thick, brimming with abundant Lightning Element. Like a brewing thundercloud, a dark tide churns beneath it. When it sprints, it tears past with the howl of a thunderstorm.

6999300.description: Sparkelves from the SylphIsle can draw energy from interactions with humans and Aniimo. The livelier and more joyful the gathering, the more energized they become.

6999301.description: Prismana Energy makes Sparkelf’s flames shimmer and flow, showing off a dazzling flair with confidence, while its bouncing movements become even more lively and playful.
